in_sanskrit.name: Rebal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Balance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rebal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rabhala', which means 'balance'. This name represents the idea of finding harmony in life, maintaining equilibrium, and achieving a state of inner peace and calmness. It is a name that resonates with those who value nature and the natural world, as well as those who strive for balance and stability in their personal and professional lives.
